### Recorded semantic rules

- `unix.file.filter_state_capability`: Every file-selection filter State reference must resolve to capability unix.file.
- `unix.file.full_path_no_traversal`: Traversal is not permitted when full_path selection is used.
- `unix.file.pattern_directory_no_traversal`: Traversal is not permitted when directory uses non-equality pattern-style selection.
